desc: 弓架单线加弯月尾端的一体二合一齿间清洁棒，随身独立包装的口腔护理款
leaf: 牙线棒（弓架二合一齿间清洁棒）
name: 弓架二合一随身牙线棒款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果页用干净暖调陶瓷展台与完整弓架线条一眼抓住有塞牙困扰的人群
shots.textZone: upper-left third: small-caps latin kicker, two-line Chinese headline, one short sub-line; lower-right one soft-cornered chip

shots.intent: 用俯拍静物把漱口、牙签、牙刷三种将就办法的局限讲清楚，制造需求而不出现口腔画面
shots.textZone: top band headline plus sub-line; three chips placed to the right of each object group

shots.intent: 把本品的弓架单线与弯月尾端和传统牙签并列，用可见结构差异完成机制说服
shots.textZone: headline top centre, one header chip per column, two proof lines under the right column

shots.intent: 以四枚方形镜头把弓架、线材、握柄、尾钩四个结构点逐一交代，替代原图功效话术
shots.textZone: headline upper left, four chips each tied by one leader line to arch, thread span, handle, tail hook

shots.intent: 用90度侧面微距证明线材是一根连续绷紧的细线，杜绝AI常见的断线与多股漂移
shots.textZone: two micro chips near the arch shoulders and one short line at the top

shots.intent: 把独立封装与随身场景结合，让观众想象把它放进包里的日常使用
shots.textZone: headline and sub-line in the left third, one chip near the pouch opening

shots.intent: 用一张可后期排版的空白卡台承接真实资质内容，避免生成任何证书或检测话术
shots.textZone: headline plus one sub-line in the upper band; the card itself stays visually empty

shots.intent: 用一张全部留白的参数表承接真实规格信息，帮买家完成选款而不编造任何数字
shots.textZone: four-row ruled table on the left, product group on the right, headline band at the top

shots.intent: 用三格匿名手部静物把取用与收尾动作讲完并以一句短促号召收口，全程不出现口腔画面
shots.textZone: headline top band, three chips under the three panels, one short closing line at the base

style.backgroundSystem: matte lime-plaster wall with an arched niche and a stepped circular ceramic pedestal in #F3EEE6; reeded glass, marble slab and gradient washes are never used
